meta.counterfactual: fossil Britain, like for like (s22): the actual system with net zero taken out; renewables' output replaced by extra running of existing fossil plant, then new CCGT/OCGT; merit-order uplift = Shao et al. 2022 (spec §15.5 item 1); gas-price feedback (Neuhoff 2022 elasticity 0.16); kept coal capped at the DUKES 5.10.B load factor
meta.residual_method: NESO demand-side, every year (departure from §4.1 2016+ FUELHH; see bills.py)
gaps: gas_break_even: linear in the gas-price rise (the dispatch is not re-run with dearer gas; second order, as in fossil_like_for_like.gas_feedback).
firm_capacity.netzero_gw by type: the LCCC obligation file has no technology split; total only.
§9.3 on-bill share: EPG green-levy transfer (Oct 2022-Jun 2023 for households not on prepayment) amounts not sourced; 2022-23 overstate the on-bill part.
Same-in-both block: supplier costs before 2017 and metering 2004-16 UNSOURCED until s21a lands; both bills are lower bounds for those years by the same amount (the gap is unaffected).
Fossil fleet gas price before Oct 2009 is DESNZ QEP 3.2.1 (power-station price), not Ofgem's Fig 5 NBP read; §15.2 decision 3 asks for NBP throughout (fossil_fleet.py fuel reader, wave A).
provenance: source ids are listed with the stored files' sha256; the full id→URL/quote map lives in data/raw/SOURCES.md (s21a registers the s18-s21 files).
Sensitivities not yet run: build-cost L/M/H and hurdle by edition, CCGT efficiency range, shape premium, batteries in the residual (spec §11).
